title: Microcommit credit velocity doodles
content:
Quick messy notes — trying to get a few microcommit primitives out before the pricing sync. Not for prod yet, mostly thinking aloud.

Goal: small $/month commitments for hobbyists/prototypes that (a) give a little predictable revenue signal, (b) provide small latency/throughput priority bump, and (c) hand out credits that encourage early usage + retention.

Ideas: microcommit tiers
- Mini (M): $5/mo -> 10k base credits (+10% velocity bonus first 3 months)
- Starter (S): $15/mo -> 40k base credits (+25% velocity first 2 months)
- Team (T): $60/mo -> 200k base credits (+10% velocity ongoing)

Notes on credits / velocity model
- Credits = fungible token-equivalent units that map to token-generation units. 1 credit ~ 1 token for simplicity in UI but internal mapping can weight embeddings heavier (eg embedding call = 4 credits per vector).
- Velocity bonus: additional credits granted as fractional multiplier on monthly credits (eg +10% = +0.1 * base) that decays after N months. Purpose: front-load value to encourage early usage.
- Decay heuristic: bonus decays 50% after month 3, then 25% per month until zero (or linear 5% per month) — open question.

Back-of-envelope unit economics (very rough)
- Assume inference GPU cost: $3.00 / GPU-hour (amortized infra + ops).
- Avg throughput for typical LLM inference at target configs: ~300 tokens/sec sustained per GPU (conservative).
  -> tokens/hr ~ 300 * 3600 = 1,080,000 tokens/hr.
  -> infra cost per token = $3 / 1,080,000 = $0.00000278/token (~$0.00278 per 1k tokens).
- Add overhead (control plane, storage, SRE): x2 multiplier -> $0.00000556/token (~$0.00556 per 1k).

Implications:
- If we sell credits at $15 for 40k credits -> $0.000375/credit (~$0.375 per 1k credits) margin is huge vs infra cost. This is because user behavior is bursty and caching + batching reduce effective cost. But we need to account for heavy tail (long-context, embeddings).
- Break-even pricing if pure throughput and no batching: price per 1k tokens to cover cost ~ $0.006 (w/ x2 overhead) — so retail price floor is low. Our premium is for SLO/priority + productization.

Microcommit-specific levers to watch
- Priority bandwidth: small reserved concurrency (e.g. 1 concurrent slot for Mini, 3 for Starter) to keep a perceivable latency win. Cost of reservation = opportunity cost of unused reserved cycles; model as % uplift on baseline infra cost.
- Rollover vs decay: allow small rollover (max 200% of monthly) but apply decay on older credit buckets to prevent hoarding.
- Anti-abuse: require billing verification / limit embeddings per minute for low tiers until KYC for enterprise.

Scenarios
- Viral prototyper: buys Starter ($15), uses 80% credits month1. Velocity bonus + caching means they hit diminishing incremental infra costs. They convert to $60 Team month3 -> lifetime value improves.
- Abuse case: script generation -> burn credits but very cheap infra (small prompts) -> loss leader ok if attention drives adoption, flag via usage patterns and throttle.

Open questions / TODOs
- Exact mapping of credit -> embedding vs generation (suggestion: embedding = 4 credits / vector; long-context generation uses per-token scaling).
- How to show remaining value to user in a simple way (convert credits -> approximate $ or approximate minutes?). UX tests needed.
- What is the margin floor we require before enabling velocity bonuses? (Tweak sample numbers above, simulate 100k user cohort).
- Legal/finance: how to treat unspent credits for revenue recognition (deferred revenue), churn modelling. Add finance check.

Quick sims to run:
- 10k microcommiters: mix 60% Mini / 30% Starter / 10% Team -> expected monthly committed rev ~ 10k*(0.6*5 + 0.3*15 + 0.1*60) = $10k*(3 + 4.5 + 6) = $135k/mo. Sketch expected token burn at 5% active usage -> translate to infra spend and margin.
- Sensitivity: increase CPU-cost multiple from x2 -> x4 to simulate worst-case ops/CORS overhead for small accounts.

Notes to self: keep UI language simple: credits + "uses" per month. Avoid per-token plumbing in initial launch message. Provide toggles for devs to view exact token math in account page.

Meeting notes style: pull these numbers into a shared sheet, run cohort sim and present to pricing sync on Thu. Flag finance re: revenue recognition. Save as draft PR for microcommit opt-in flow.

End of dump. Need to tidy before sharing externally.
